identity: Independent high precision reference for Mašín 2026 VIBE published explicit Appendix A formulation; disclosed body Eq27 discrepancy retained
independence: Do not read production candidate or execute backend/vendor code. Decimal arbitrary precision, Cartesian 3x3 matrices, fourth order action by components; construct and directly solve 6x6 B matrix with pivoted elimination rather than using rank-one inverse. Standard library only.

precision.transcendentals: Decimal ln/exp/sqrt; sin and cos Taylor with explicit 110-digit pi; no binary float equation arithmetic

state_and_controls: Compression-positive Mandel net stress6, e, a_scan; external physical seconds, suction Pa, temperature K and prescribed strain/suction/temperature rates; convert tensors into source compression-negative frame and return negative source stress rate.

branch_study.meaning: Explicit project sensitivity study; not claimed BCV calibration

contexts.near_SBS: e=.725, scan=.35 unless stated, s=10MPa,T=294K; determine isotropic compression net pressure by Decimal bisection at each parameter set to OA=1.005; 1Pa to30MPa bracket, 400 iterations. All other variables current algebra.
contexts.anisotropy: Near-SBS net stress plus tracefree Mandel offsets [2000,-1000,-1000,3000,-2000,1000]Pa

points: BCV near-SBS six independent strain-rate Mandel basis probes at +2e-8/s and their negatives
BCV anisotropic hold and full mixed mechanical rate [2,-1,3,-2,1,-3]e-8/s
BCV wetting and drying at suction rates -2000,+2000Pa/s
BCV heating and cooling at temperature rates +.02,-.02K/s
BCV scanning endpoints scan0/1 with both suction directions
branch_study wet/dry/heat/cool and opposing mixed THM
invalid_cases: e below em giving negative eM

trajectories.controls: all mechanical rates zero; suction+2000Pa/s and temperature+.02K/s
all mechanical/temperature rates zero; suction+2000Pa/s first50s, -2000Pa/s next50s; split exactly at50s

integration.method: Classical explicit RK4 on full 8-state vector, fixed partitions, prescribed controls sampled at every RK stage
integration.reference_precision_check: Repeat finest256 partitions at70digits versus50digits. Compare finest two partitions at70digits; no production observations before reference freeze. A failing case remains failed; any revised study requires new identity.
integration.trajectory_outputs: Initial/final full state and derived em,eM,S_M,Sr,OA,re; endpoint rates; convergence discrepancies; no claim intermediate states experimentally validated

acceptance.comparison: abs(a-b)<=absolute+relative*max(abs(a),abs(b)); all components must pass. Reference precision convergence must satisfy same gates; retain all failures.

guards: Finite inputs, positive s/T/pr/hms/lp and thermal factor, e>em>0,eM>0,0<=scan<=1,positive pm/pM/lam/lact/Iv, 0<S_M<1,0<=Fm<1,OA>=1,nonzero denominators. Source hydrostatic continuous product extension only; no clipping/projection. Invalid cases must fail explicitly. No constant branch memory at zero suction rate.
prospective_limits: Finite-case reference study only. No source experiment reproduction, scientific admission, production/backend or browser qualification. No prescribed success threshold on relaxation magnitude; report measured reference change. Full physical-time trial/rollback belongs to coordinator integration tests.
